correctness.rationale: For each of 52 rational point-line flags over F3, the four independent homogeneous tangent-contact conditions are exhaustively enumerated by 3^11 kernel vectors, scalar-normalized and checked for nonzero transverse differential. There are 9,997 candidates with at least five flags: each has a rational point with zero full gradient by two independent implementations (one pure standard-library), so no geometrically smooth quartic can have five. Exactly 52,884 rationally nonsingular four-flag candidates split under four generators of PGL3(F3) into 18 complete orbits. Exact three-chart Groebner Jacobian ideals show only the 1872-,234-,234-member orbits are geometrically smooth. Independent explicit derivative arguments and direct four-contact witnesses verify all survivors. Full source and finite data accompany the theorem; geometric smoothness does not follow merely from the rational screening.

value.rationale: Rational order-four tangent contact is a natural arithmetic invariant of the canonical embedding of smooth genus-three nonhyperelliptic curves. An exact sharp bound over the smallest odd field in exceptional characteristic three, combined with a complete projective classification and distinct rational point configurations, has intrinsic classification value beyond bitangent or automorphism counts.
